metadata.og:title: AIDE²: First Evidence of Recursive Self-Improvement | Weco AI
metadata.twitter:description: We ran autoresearch on autoresearch: an outer loop rewriting its own research agent for 100 unattended steps. In eight days it discovered agents that beat our two years of hand-tuning on held-out benchmarks, and taught itself to reward hack less.
